rows.text: In the hidden alleyways of every city-state, there are always vendors peddling Titan's blessings, like Death Experience Pills, Elixirs of Wisdom, and Honeyed Tongue Oils. That blasphemous scale dust is also one of the products. Merchants claim that it takes a hundred golden butterflies to produce a single pouch of the insect scale dust. Once applied to the eyes, even the most wrinkled old woman appears as a walking incarnation of Mnestia. Given the bizarre social incidents this powder has caused, most city-states have classified it as a banned substance.
